uart.crc: CRC32/ISO-HDLC over header and payload, little endian

url_push.same_url: renew canonical queued id without shortening remaining duration
url_push.source: HTTP(S) JPEG or MJPEG, detected from response
url_push.timer: starts after first decoded and presented frame

push_update.duration_ms: extend to at least requested visible time
push_update.position: preserved, hidden updates do not select
push_update.dedup: send retains original creation fingerprint; UART sequence retries are deduplicated
push_update.ttl_bytes: optional LE32 after mask, before source when bit 14 is present
push_update.ttl_ms: reset hard expiry from receipt; zero disables

ttl_ms.clock: monotonic including hidden, queued and suspended time

overflow.drop_oldest: evict oldest waiting notice, preserve active

push_policy.timer_relation: ttl expiry is independent of visible duration and applies to confirm notices

measurement_warmup.location: status.get data and HTTP business status
measurement_warmup.unknown: null or absent; includes stopped measurement and snapshot age >=20000 ms
measurement_warmup.zero: measurement warmup elapsed; does not imply a valid sample
measurement_warmup.source: MCU measurement phase clock, independent of calibration session
measurement_warmup.age: ESP subtracts floor(monotonic snapshot age /1000), clamps at zero; WebUI subtracts local response age and stops displaying the countdown after 20000 ms without a new response
measurement_warmup.compatibility: optional read-only extension, ignored by older clients; existing sample valid flag remains authoritative

configuration.persistence: existing ESP screen settings transactional record; replay on each MCU session
configuration.effect: recompute from current measurement elapsed time without restarting measurement; never set an invalid sample valid

uart_rx_recovery.trigger: observed hardware RX overrun or receive-ring dropped byte
uart_rx_recovery.owner_action: discard buffered fragments and resynchronize parser through the next zero delimiter; preserve CRC, session and sequence validation

guard_diagnostic.v4_prefix: existing 82-byte v3 fields unchanged except version byte is 4
guard_diagnostic.hardware_rx_overruns: observed RXOV events, not a dropped-byte count
guard_diagnostic.last_rx_loss_ms: boot monotonic milliseconds; zero before any observed loss
guard_diagnostic.compatibility: new ESP accepts exact v3 or v4 lengths and versions; v3 has no loss fields; older ESP may ignore v4 diagnostic notices without changing media wire framing
guard_diagnostic.exposure: four appended loss fields are returned only by explicit maintenance queries screen.recovery.get and screen.boot.result.get; ordinary business status retains the original 20 diagnostic fields

display_page_policy.home_page_id: stable enabled scene page.id; 0 selects first enabled page
display_page_policy.page_overrides: up to 8 unique existing page IDs; absent entry inherits all global standby fields; each entry requires page_id, external_minutes, battery_minutes and idle_brightness
display_page_policy.priority: global weekly plans take precedence; zero minutes disables idle timeout; zero brightness switches the backlight off
display_page_policy.compatibility: old 6-field requests preserve home/overrides; extended 8-field requests require PAGE_POLICY; old MCU receives v1 368-byte policy, new MCU v2 472-byte policy; v1 persisted records load with home=0 and no overrides
display_page_policy.status: new fields only in explicit display get/set replies; ordinary status remains compact
display_page_policy.identity: page sorting preserves stable IDs; deleted page overrides are pruned; disabled page overrides retained; disabled/deleted home falls back to 0
display_page_policy.revision: unchanged saves preserve revision and storage; actual changes persist transactionally and replay by revision
